content.text: The only MFN provision runs in our favour, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The sole most-favoured-nation provision (§ 7.6) is granted by Brightline in our favour: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to us will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers, with a reasonable comparability qualifier ("comparable volumes and terms"). Nothing in §§ 4, 7 or 30, or elsewhere in the document (searches for "favourable", MFN, match-rights and third-party-terms language returned no other hits), obliges Northwind to extend Brightline best terms given to any third party or to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position — no MFN obligation burdens the Customer — so no redline is proposed; the Vendor-granted MFN is retained as beneficial to us.
